FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
internal-reexports-from-external: supports namespaces with external star reexports
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
deopt-string-concatenation: deoptimize concatenation when used as an expression statement to better support es5-shim
advanced-esm: load an ESM-only rollup plugin from node_modules as well as CJS plugins
no-treeshake-react: passes when bundling React without tree-shaking
supports-core-js: supports core-js feature detection (#2869)
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
break-statement-loops: breaks control flow when a break statement is encountered inside a loop
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
does-not-fail-for-arguments-test: does not fail when non-integer arguments properties are accessed
function-id-as-parameter: allows function expression parameters to shadow their id
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
side-effect-e: accounts for local scopes when tested function purity
side-effects-generators: Properly detect side-effects in generator functions
side-effects-es6-class-expressions: determine side effects in ES6 class expressions
dynamic-import-this-arrow: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when using arrow functions
caught-errors: breaks control flow when an error is thrown inside a catch block
